en.title: Number of Substrings Where the Count of Zeros Equals the Square of the Count of Ones
en.description:
Count the non-empty binary substrings in which the number of 0s equals the square of the number of 1s. Different index ranges are counted separately.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: One line with a 01 string of length 1..100000.
en.explanation: Example 1: the three length-2 ranges 01, 01 and 10, plus the whole 010001, 4 in total. Example 2: three adjacent 01 or 10 ranges, 3 in total. Example 3: a single 0 does not satisfy 1=0², so the answer is 0.
hints: If there are k ones, the substring length must be k²+k with k≥1. So enumerate at most √n values of k, and for that fixed length use prefix sums of the count of 1s to check every start.
